title: Conversation Viewer per-turn and full-conversation audio playback
summary: Browser-side Conversation Viewer TTS is integration-ready: per-turn play buttons, full-conversation queued playback, pause/resume/stop, speed and speaker filters, active-turn highlighting, plus Scientist/Literal/Skip math speech modes that prevent raw Markdown/LaTeX delimiter speech such as 'lambda dollars dollars'.

epistemic.publication_status: ready for Sites integration; not live-deployed by this packet

follow_up: Load conversation-viewer-tts-entry.js as an ES module in the live Conversation Viewer.
If auto-detection misses the live turn wrapper, add its stable selector to the bootstrap.
Run the acceptance test in the build handoff, especially the $$ lambda $$ delimiter regression.

provenance.note: Built from Nathan's direct request for per-turn/full-conversation text-to-audio and subsequent preference for scientist-style equation verbalization.
